name: relp_region_student_apples_enpt
objective: Run an apples-to-apples EN->PT comparison where the low-rank region-student contract uses the same ReLP mask discovery and FLORES/NTREX data pipeline as the strongest prior EN->PT approach.

why.problem: Issue 31 mixed three variables: ACDC mask discovery, DataDesigner-derived training data, and the low-rank region-student implementation. The follow-up original-region control showed the ACDC 160k region is capable, but it did not normalize mask discovery or data construction against the strongest prior method.
why.fixed_comparison: Use the #23/#28 ReLP + FLORES teacher-hyp + NTREX held-out pipeline, then change only the student-region implementation contract.

references.prior_winner_condition: k=160000 ReLP fixed mask, r8 LoRA lens, NTREX EN->PT XCOMET-XXL

data.train_source: FLORES EN->PT devtest JSONL translated by unmasked HY-MT into model_hyp targets
data.attribution_source: FLORES EN->PT dev split sampled by attribute_translation.py
data.heldout_eval: NTREX EN->PT test split truncated to 1012 rows
data.heldout_policy: NTREX must not be used for training, attribution, or mask selection
data.synthetic_data_policy: Do not use issue30/DataDesigner synthetic data for the first apples-to-apples comparison

region_discovery.method: ReLP translation attribution from the prior fixed-mask pipeline

student_region.rank_policy: Start with the best #31-style anchor rank first; expand only if the first result is not clearly negative.
student_region.teacher: unmasked HY-MT logits on FLORES teacher-hyp rows
student_region.training_data: same FLORES teacher-hyp rows used by the prior fixed-mask pipeline

minimum_run: Build or restore FLORES teacher-hyp train data.
Build or restore NTREX held-out eval data.
Evaluate teacher/no-mask and ReLP k=160k original-region control.
Train one region-student at rank 128 using the same ReLP mask and FLORES teacher-hyp data.
Evaluate the region-student on NTREX and score with XCOMET-XXL.
Post the comparison table before expanding.

interpretation.student_still_weak: If the region student remains far below the ReLP original-region control, the region-student contract is the dominant failure.
interpretation.student_recovers: If the region student closes most of the gap to original-region control, issue31 was confounded by ACDC and/or synthetic data choices.
interpretation.anchor_fails: If the ReLP original-region control itself is unexpectedly weak, stop and fix the recreated prior anchor before training students.

weights_policy: Do not upload Tencent HY-MT, XCOMET weights, Hugging Face cache directories, API keys, or service tokens.
